summary: Repaired the T069 CLI cancel branch in src/robinhood_lp/__main__.py: the replacement RunRecord now passes simulation_evidence_path=None beside the sibling optional fields (a cancelled run publishes no manifest, report or simulation evidence; the source link the request carried is preserved so the rerun chain stays traceable). Before the repair, `python -m robinhood_lp backtest cancel` on any non-terminal (QUEUED/RUNNING) record aborted with TypeError: RunRecord.__init__() missing 1 required positional argument: 'simulation_evidence_path' (reproduced in this worktree, and reported by scoped mypy at the same call site). Added regression coverage in tests/test_backtest_t069.py (new class TestCLICancelNonTerminalRun, three tests plus two helpers): cancelling a RUNNING record through the CLI subprocess yields exit 0 with a CANCELLED terminal record whose reason_code/creation time are preserved and whose manifest/report/simulation-evidence paths stay None; cancelling a QUEUED rerun record preserves its source link and checksum and still links to no new evidence; an unknown run_id still fails closed with exit 1, no stdout and no record written. No behavior, interface, dependency, Intent/Spec or safety-policy change; only the two declared allowed_paths were modified and nothing was committed.
